//: Which version of each cited Act the clause library was written against.
458 citations across the library name an Act and a section, and none of them
records the version relied on. A citation that looks right long after the
section it points at was amended is worse than no citation: it carries the
authority of a checked reference without the substance of one.
They collapse to 73 distinct Acts, so this is 73 decisions rather than 458.
For each Act the supervising advocate should set `amended_upto` to the date
the text was verified as in force, `source` to where it was read, and flip
`verified` to true. scripts/checkStatuteCitations.mjs resolves every citation
through this file, so filling one row pins every clause that cites that Act.
`verified: false` is the honest default. It does not mean the citation is
wrong -- it means nobody has confirmed it against the current text.

schema.amended_upto: ISO date the Act text was verified as in force, or null
schema.source: Where it was read (India Code URL, gazette reference, or a named commentary)
schema.verified: true only once a person has actually checked it
schema.note: Anything the reviewer wants recorded — a pending amendment, a repeal, a state variation
schema.repealed_on: ISO date the Act ceased to have effect. A clause may not cite an Act that carries this field.
schema.superseded_by: The Act or Code to cite instead.
schema.in_force_from: ISO date the Act commenced, where that matters for transitional questions.

Code on Social Security, 2020.note: In force 21 November 2025. Repeals the Employees' Compensation Act 1923, ESI Act 1948, EPF Act 1952, Maternity Benefit Act 1961, Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 and others. Verified: s.53 gratuity (five years continuous service, fifteen days wages per completed year, death and disablement exceptions); s.60 maternity benefit (twenty-six weeks); s.67 creche; Chapter III (ss.14-23) EPF; Chapter IV (ss.24-52) ESI. TRANSITIONAL: per the Labour Ministry FAQs, gratuity for service before 21 November 2025 remains governed by the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972.

Code on Wages, 2019.note: In force 21 November 2025. Repeals the Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and Equal Remuneration Act 1976. Verified sections: 2(y) wages definition with the one-half proviso; 5 minimum rate of wages; 17(2) wages payable within two working days of removal, dismissal, retrenchment or resignation; 18 deductions; 26(1) minimum bonus 8.33 per cent or one hundred rupees.

Employees Provident Funds Act, 1952.note: REPEALED 21 November 2025. Cite Code on Social Security, 2020 instead. No clause in this library may cite this Act; scripts/checkStatuteCitations.mjs fails the build if one does.
